sources.owner: Mac OS X Tiger help-tag documentation preserved by Flylib
Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Apple Computer, Inc., 8 September 2005

window_frame.note: Finder Home records the 1px silver edge, seven-ish pixel top corner, bottom status band, and resize ridges.

title_bar.note: Finder Home records a 22px title row unified with a brushed-metal toolbar; the full combined top is 54px.

window_buttons.note: Finder verifies the leading 14px red/yellow/green glass controls at 21px centre spacing, glyphless at rest, seated one pixel below the brushed-metal highlight; the production crop is held to the native 1x reference by an enforced RGB tolerance.

toolbar.note: The 54px top crop preserves the unified title/toolbar material, segmented view control, search field, and disclosure capsule.

buttons.note: Appearance preserves the rounded glass Show All button and small help button at native 1x.

choice_controls.note: Appearance preserves rounded silver value wells with a narrow blue gel up/down segment.

fields.note: Finder Home and Appearance preserve white inset search/value fields and blue focus halo.

menus.note: Apple Menu preserves pinstriped white rows, blue selection, rules, submenu arrows, shortcuts, and hard lower shadow.

popovers.note: Apple's own Tiger-period HIG (8 September 2005) prints Figure 5-11, a help tag under the pointer in iTunes: a 125x18 pale-yellow plate with a one-pixel warm-gray edge, a soft dark shadow below and right, near-square corners, and dark Lucida Grande text one line high. Placement below and right of the pointer is part of the figure.

scrollbars.note: System Profiler records a 15px track, 387px blue gel thumb, silver arrow plates grouped at the trailing end, and bottom resize corner. The native vertical resting state is verified below; horizontal and pressed-state evidence is still required before the whole component family can be called verified.

lists_tables.note: System Profiler and Finder preserve white rows, blue opaque selection, disclosure triangles, separators, and sidebar widths.

progress.note: Finder Copy preserves Tiger's thin determinate blue gel fill, pale rounded track, file label, remaining-size line, document icon, and circular stop plate.

alerts_toasts.note: Finder's Eject Warning preserves the light-gray rounded sheet, red octagonal stop icon, compact title/body stack, and blue default OK capsule.

typography.note: Lucida Grande is visible across Finder, System Preferences, menus, and System Profiler at original 1x.

icons.note: Applications preserves Finder sidebar and application artwork; app semantics should use period-shaped originals only where licensing permits.

tolerance.method: Full-crop native-1x RGB RMSE after exact 61×23 size validation, plus native-pixel review of the 14px lenses, 21px centre spacing, glyphless resting state, dark upper arcs, lower-face bloom, and brushed-metal seating. RGB comparison intentionally ignores the historical screenshot's partially transparent rounded window-corner pixel.

reproductions.note: Production WindowTitleBandView rendered at the crop's native 61×23 pixels with the active leading traffic-light cluster. The authored Tiger lens keeps its measured upper-third dip, lower bloom, spherical side walls, asymmetric rim, compact spacing, and restrained brushed-metal background.

tolerance.method: Full-crop native-1x RGB RMSE after exact 15×479 size validation, plus native-pixel review of the asymmetric trough, 387px thumb, twelve-column recolorable gel shaft, seven-row end-cap ramps, and paired 15×15 arrow plates. The crop retains a few adjacent System Profiler list-edge pixels that production intentionally does not reproduce.

reproductions.note: Production ThemedScroller rendered against the tight 15×479 control extraction. Its trough and flat shaft match the measured pixels, the thumb length is exact, and both trailing arrow plates are pixel-identical; the wider crop remains above as list-edge and resize-corner context.

Production Aqua Help Tag recipe at the measured Tiger 125×18 grammar: pale-yellow compact plate, near-square corner, one-pixel warm edge, and no speech stem. The HIG plate is a component reference, so this remains pending visual review rather than an automatic pixel-equality claim.
